drhp.business: The Company primarily derives its revenue from providing technical support services and leasing of infrastructure facilities. It has leased hangar space and buildings to an MRO organization and also generates revenue from the usage of infrastructure facilities, including runway and hangar operations. The hangar leasing arrangement is long-dated - the notes state the Company has entered into lease transactions mainly for leasing of hangars for a period of 25 years, with terms of renewal, the Company acting as lessor.

risks.note: MD&A Risks and Concerns states major revenue is derived from a single customer; any reduction in business from this customer could materially impact revenue and profitability. With income concentrated in technical support services and hangar/infrastructure leasing to one MRO organization, the whole revenue base rests on one counterparty.

Explicitly flagged: any delay in receipt of lease rentals from the major customer and the consequent increase in outstanding receivables may adversely impact the maintenance and upkeep of the infrastructure - i.e. a collection delay degrades the revenue-earning asset itself.
risks.risk: Delay in receipt of lease rentals and build-up of receivables
